snippet.title: Broken Ranks: Trials of the Lodge - Announcement Trailer | MMORPG + Roguelite Mode Update
snippet.description:
⚔️ Broken Ranks: Trials of the Lodge - Coming December 16! ⚔️
👉 https://brokenranks.com

🔥 Get ready for the Trials of the Lodge - a brand-new mode bringing a dose of top-tier roguelite experience into our MMORPG world. Randomized paths, varied enemies, shifting effects… in short: every run will feel different.

If challenges don’t scare you and you enjoy tactical, “in-the-moment” decision-making, this one’s right up your alley 💪

Join us on:
👉 https://www.facebook.com/BrokenRanks
👉 https://www.facebook.com/WhitemoonGames
👉 https://www.reddit.com/r/BrokenRanksOfficial
👉 https://twitter.com/PlayBrokenRanks
